text:
maya: Heads-up — PR #4352 (https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4352) is blocked by a flaky integ on shard-3. Failing test: renderer_snapshot_test (mac). Need a quick approve for a targeted rerun or advice on whether we should update snapshots.

ravi: Thanks for the ping. Seen this twice in a row, looks nondet. Did this PR touch any rendering code?

maya: No rendering changes, only metric/export refactor. Reproduced locally? I couldn't repro.

ci-bot: [buildkite] job 9876 failed on shard-3 — RendererMismatchError at compare_snapshot. Log snippet:
```
compare_snapshot: expected hash=0x1a2b3c got=0x1a2b4c
image diff: 12px area around top-left (font fallback?)
stack: /.../render/compare.go:142
```

leo: That 12px drift smells like font fallback or DPI rounding. We saw similar on mac matrix when system fonts updated. If PR didn't touch renderer, a targeted rerun is reasonable.

maya: OK I'll ask for an approve for the rerun. @jen can you approve a targeted rerun during the merge window? (react: :pray:)

jen: I'm OOO today but can approve a single targeted rerun if it's just to check flakiness. :+1:

ravi: I triggered the targeted rerun: `/rerun-targeted 4352 shard=3` — buildkite shows job 9880 in the queue.

ci-bot: [buildkite] targeted rerun triggered for PR #4352 (job 9880) by ravi.

ci-bot: [buildkite] job 9880 finished — PASS on shard-3. Artifact: https://bk.artifacts/9880/snap-diff.png (small whitespace diff in header)

maya: Nice. The diff looks like a timestamp format change in the rendered header (not introduced by this PR).

leo: If it's purely timestamp formatting, and PR didn't change rendering, I'd prefer to keep snapshots and rely on reruns. If you want to be safe, update snapshot with `make update-snapshots` in a follow-up.

maya: Agreed. Since job passed, merging now to avoid blocking the queue. Will open a follow-up if the diff reappears. (react: :shipit:)

ravi: Thanks all. Filing a short note in the PR to track potential mac font drift.

maya: Done — PR merged. Closing thread.
